newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to record low 2.115 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to record low 2.115 pct.

text.p: The yield of the benchmark three percent 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) fell to a record low of 2.115 percent in early afternoon on Monday.
The yield ended at 2.120 percent on Friday in Tokyo.
Traders said the rally was spearheaded by short-covering by traders and better-than-expected sales of corporate bonds to end-investors.
About 250 billion yen worth of corporate straight bonds were issued on Monday, which had previously been expected to depress the JGBs, traders said.
